stories.title: F5 releases emergency patches for critical BIG-IP RCE flaws
stories.summary: US cybersecurity company F5 warned customers to patch five critical BIG-IP vulnerabilities that attackers can exploit to trigger denial-of-service (DoS) or gain remote code execution.

stories.title: New Unpatched Windows 0-Day FastUnlock Lets Someone Holding a Locked PC Run Programs on It
stories.summary: A newly disclosed unpatched zero-day technique called FastUnlock lets someone with physical access to a locked Windows computer start programs without signing in. Whoever uses it gets only a limited account, not administrator control of the machine. The method was posted yesterday by a researcher who uses the handles MSNightmare and Nightmare Eclipse, and the endpoint-security firm ThreatLocker

stories.title: Hackers Exploit Critical Cisco Expressway Flaw, Breach Four Devices and Reach Internal Network
stories.summary: Threat actors have been observed exploiting a recently disclosed critical security flaw in Cisco Expressway to breach a Russian organization shortly after the public release of a proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit. The activity involves the exploitation of CVE-2026-76466 (CVSS score: 9.8), a vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker with network access to a Cisco Expressway

stories.title: Five warning signs of ransomware breach before encryption or data theft
stories.summary: Ransomware attacks often involve credential theft, lateral movement, and attempts to disable security controls long before encryption begins. Acronis examines five warning signs that can help defenders detect intrusions earlier, contain malicious activity, and protect critical systems and backups.

stories.title: Newly Patched VMware vCenter Flaw Exploited as Zero-Day by Chinese APT
stories.summary: Google says a China-linked espionage group exploited a critical VMware vCenter authentication bypass before Broadcom released a patch.

stories.title: China-Linked Hackers Exploit Critical VMware vCenter Zero-Day to Gain Admin Access and Steal Data
stories.summary: The suspected China-nexus cyber espionage group known as Armory Castle (formerly UNC5221) has been attributed to the zero-day exploitation of a critical security flaw in VMware vCenter Server in early September 2026. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-123890 (CVSS score: 9.8), is a case of authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service that could be exploited to gain unauthorized

stories.title: VMware patches vCenter zero-day exploited in attacks since September
stories.summary: Broadcom has released security updates to fix a critical VMware vCenter Server authentication bypass vulnerability that Chinese-linked hackers have exploited in zero-day attacks since September 2026.

stories.title: Drupal Patches Critical Installer Flaw That Could Give Unauthenticated Attackers Control of Sites
stories.summary: Under specific conditions, a critical vulnerability in Drupal core can allow an attacker without login credentials to use the built-in installer to attempt to reinstall a site.
